details: Training/query/gallery contain 8,675 / 1,715 / 8,575 unique sorted names, 50 training and 50 test identities with disjoint identity sets, eight camera codes, and scene=-1. All four native/training manifests are identical.

Independently parsed every filename into identity and zero-based camera; matched every archive name/ID/camera/scene. Queries overlap gallery files by design; same-identity/same-camera rows are removed before ranking. No model output supplies benchmark labels.

The evaluation is a custom standard ReID calculation with dataset filename labels. An upstream official evaluator was not independently fetched. Original raw installed dataset provenance is bounded by W04.

AP is the mean of relevant-hit precision, INP is relevant-count / last-relevant rank, and CMC derives from first relevant rank after the same-camera exclusion. Reported percentages average queries and multiply by 100; no prediction maximum/mean/minimum normalizes the metric.

L2 feature normalization and internal attention normalization are model operations, not self-normalization of benchmark scores. Complete independent distance reductions match all saved per-query rows, six metrics, CMC1-50 and group summaries.
